## [1.1.2](https://github.com/CozyCode890/HoiTruyenChu-patches/compare/v1.1.1...v1.1.2) (2026-11-14)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* sync the reading history right after logging in ([22ff088](https://github.com/CozyCode890/HoiTruyenChu-patches/commit/22ff088756131405416ffcc6960d4105a98256c3))

patches.name: Auto sync reading history
patches.description: Syncs the reading history with the iTruyenChu account without pressing the sync button: free chapters 1-50, which the server never sees, are recorded too, and the progress from other devices is merged in (with book titles) when the app starts and right after logging in. The "Đồng bộ" button also works when the bookshelf is empty.

patches.name: Background reading
patches.description: Keeps reading with the screen off: React Native pauses JS timers when the app goes to the background, which stops the app from starting the next chapter. JS timers keep running while a reading session is active.

patches.name: Fix Google login
patches.description: Fixes "Đăng nhập với Google" failing with error 400: the server now expects the Firebase ID token (like the website) instead of the email sent by this app version.

patches.name: Resume listening position
patches.description: Opening a book from the bookshelf or "Đọc truyện" goes back to the line where the listening stopped: the voice bar opens with the play button and the line is highlighted, pressing play continues from there.

patches.name: Show chapter titles
patches.description: Shows the real chapter titles instead of "Vô Đề Mục" in the chapter list, the reader and the TTS: books whose chapter list only has "Chương N" get the title from the first line of the chapter text (public preview, no login needed), cached on the device.

patches.name: TTS media controls
patches.description: The media widget / lock screen shows the TTS reading instead of the silent 6 s file of the voice bar: playing or paused, the position in the chapter (line x/y). Its play / pause and next / previous buttons work like the voice bar's buttons (next / previous chapter), and the previous chapter button of the voice bar, which did nothing, opens the previous chapter.

patches.name: TTS reliability
patches.description: Fixes text-to-speech reading that stops after a phone call or does nothing when pressing play: re-creates the TTS engine when it dies, pauses during calls and resumes afterwards, retries failed lines, uses the correct Vietnamese voice, and applies a new speed right away instead of after pause + play.
